POV: you finally found a use for the MacBook notch 🖤 When Apple put a notch on the MacBook, most of us just learned to ignore it. I couldn't. So I started building Argon, a Mac app that turns that little black cutout into the most useful part of the screen. Here's what it does right now: 🎵 Shows what's playing, with the album art and controls, the moment you hover over it 👆 Responds to swipe gestures, so you can control things without clicking around 🌤️ Gives you the weather without opening an app 📁 Holds files you drag into it, so you can move them or AirDrop them later 🎧 Shows your AirPods battery when they connect 🔋 Shows the charge when you plug in 🔊 Replaces the volume pop-up with something that fits the notch ⏱️ Keeps your timers counting down at the top of the screen And when you don't need it, it shrinks back into a plain notch, so it never gets in your way. You can have it in frosted glass that blends with your wallpaper, or pure black that looks like part of the hardware. I'm still adding features and sharing every step here. If there's something you wish your notch could do, comment it below. The best ideas might end up in the app. 👇 Follow to see what it learns to do next. #macapps #macbook #macos #apple #viral

Apple’s first touchscreen MacBook Pro is finally here, and this might be one of the most exciting MacBook redesigns in years. The new 2026 MacBook Pro features a tandem OLED PROLED XDR display, multi-touch support, Dynamic Island, a lighter design, and even the return of the glowing Apple logo! Powered by the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, Apple’s new OLED MacBook Pro also offers up to 24 hours of battery life. The 14-inch starts at $2899 and the 16-inch starts at $3399, with availability beginning November 6.
